# Indexing a scalar is a type error; array bounds are a separate error.
4[0] => error:expected array
let n = 4; n[0] => error:expected array
(2 + 3)[0] => error:expected array
fn f() { 7 }; f()[0] => error:expected array
fn f() { 7 }; f[0] => error:expected array
[9][0][0] => error:expected array
let xs = [9]; xs[0] => 9
[9][1] => error:array index out of bounds
4[1 / 0] => error:division by zero
4[0 => error:expected closing bracket
0 && 4[1 / 0] => 0
1 || 4[1 / 0] => 1
if 1 { [5][0] } else { 4[0] } => 5
